blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.
blocks.zh: 人造机器人的一个中心目标是让机器人从事人们在家庭和工作场所的日常工作。 现有的以自我为中心的视频数据集涵盖了许多这些活动,但很少提供同步的全身运动数据,用于在规模上学习loco操纵. 我们建造了Awaken-Human, 它将大约5万小时的自我中心立体声视频 与同步的全身人体运动, 并覆盖超过100个技能。 在此基础上,我们还引入了Awaken-HI(Humanoid Intelligence),这是人造Loco-操纵的视觉语言动作模型,通过共同行动专家共同预测人类原始运动和重定向机器人动作. 我们显示,当人类的轨迹直接监督共同行动专家时,机能操纵技能会更有效地从人转移到人类。 根据经验缩放定律,增加人类预训数据可以减少被搁置的机器人动作预测错误,并提高下游真机器人任务的平均成功率。 Awaken-HI经过全公司预训和T800改造后,在8项个人任务中取得了93.75%的平均成功率,在个人和长期评价中都超过了GR00T N1.7和0.5美元。 同样的政策一般适用于机器人训练后未见的物体以及熟悉的物体和目的地的新配对。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Humanoid robots could help people with a wide range of tasks in homes and workplaces.
Many require whole-body loco-manipulation, in which the robot coordinates its steps and posture with its hand movements [ 17 , 24 ] .
Vision-language-action (VLA) models [ 5 , 16 , 31 ] and world action models [ 47 , 22 , 48 ] have shown that robots can learn diverse manipulation skills from demonstrations.
For humanoids, however, the cost of whole-body teleoperation limits the range of tasks and environments represented in robot demonstrations [ 13 , 49 ] .
blocks.zh:
人造机器人可以帮助在家庭和工作场所承担广泛任务的人。
许多人需要全身的自控,其中机器人会用手动来协调其步骤和姿态[17,24].
视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型[5,16,31]和世界行动模型[47,22,48]显示机器人可以从演示中学习出不同的操纵技巧.
然而,对于人造人来说,全身远程操作的成本限制了机器人演示中体现的任务和环境范围[13,49].

blocks.en:
Human experience of everyday activity offers a more scalable alternative to robot teleoperation.
Recent work draws on the variety of activities and environments in these videos [ 46 , 43 ] to pretrain manipulation policies [ 41 , 52 , 23 ] .
Despite this diversity, visual observations alone provide no explicit targets for whole-body motion.
Prior work therefore retargets recorded human motion to obtain robot action targets [ 7 , 21 ] .
However, differences in body proportions and joint structure can cause the resulting postures and hand trajectories to deviate from those in the human demonstration [ 2 ] .
These deviations motivate retaining the original human motion as a training signal alongside the retargeted robot actions.
Using that signal at scale requires egocentric video paired with synchronized whole-body motion across diverse tasks and environments.
Yet many large egocentric datasets provide video alone or primarily track the head and hands [ 11 , 15 ] , while datasets such as Nymeria [ 28 ] offer only a few hundred hours of paired recordings.
blocks.zh:
人类日常活动的经验为机器人远程操作提供了更可扩展的替代品.
最近的工作借鉴了这些视频中的各种活动和环境[46、43],以预先训练操纵政策[41、52、23]。
尽管存在这种多样性,光是视觉观察并不能为全身运动提供明确的目标.
因此,先前的工作重定目标记录了人类获得机器人动作目标的运动[7,21].
然而,身体比例和联想结构的差异会使由此产生的姿势和手轨偏离了人类演示中的姿势和手轨[2].
这些偏差激发了将原始人类运动作为训练信号与被重新瞄准的机器人动作一起保留下去的动力.
使用这种规模的信号需要以自我为中心的视频配对,同时进行不同任务和环境的同步全身运动.
然而许多以自我为中心的大型数据集只提供视频或主要跟踪头和手[11,15],而Nymeria[28]等数据集只提供几百小时的对接录音.

blocks.en:
We address this data gap with Awaken-Human, a dataset for humanoid pretraining that pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion.
Collected under a common protocol using lightweight wearable sensors, the demonstrations cover more than 100 skills across homes, workplaces, retail spaces, and storage areas.
We reconstruct 3D hand motion from the video and annotate the demonstrations with subtask descriptions and frame-level depth maps.
For each demonstration, we retain the original human trajectory alongside the corresponding retargeted robot actions.
blocks.zh:
我们用Awaken-Human来弥补这个数据差距, 这个用于人体预演的数据集 将大约5万小时的自负式立体声视频 与整个人体同步运动对齐。
示范活动通过使用轻量级可穿戴感应器的通用协议收集,涵盖超过100种技能,跨越家庭、工作场所、零售空间和储存地。
我们从视频中重建出3D手动,并用子任务描述和帧层深度图对演示进行注释.
对于每个演示,我们保留原始的人类轨迹,同时保留相应的被重新瞄准的机器人动作.

blocks.en:
Building on Awaken-Human, we introduce Awaken-HI, a VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation.
By predicting human motion alongside retargeted robot actions, its shared action expert receives direct supervision from the original human trajectories.
During pretraining, the expert also predicts camera-frame wrist poses, while separate heads estimate current and future depth and describe the current subtask.
We then post-train the policy on approximately 150 hours of T800 teleoperation data using the same robot action interface.
blocks.zh:
在Awaken-Human的基础上,我们引入了Awaken-HI,一种用于人造Loco-操纵的VLA模型.
通过预测人类运动与再定向机器人动作,其共享动作专家直接接受人类原始轨迹的直接监督.
在前期训练期间,专家还预测相机框腕姿势,而相隔头则估计了当前和未来深度并描述了当前子任务.
然后我们用同一个机器人动作界面,对大约150小时的T800远程操作数据进行政策培训。

blocks.en:
We observe that Awaken-HI’s robot action prediction error on held-out data follows an empirical scaling law, decreasing as the pretraining set grows from 5,000 to 50,000 hours of human demonstrations.
With the same T800 demonstrations for post-training, more human pretraining data also raises the policy’s mean success rate on three household tasks.
Controlled ablations show that adding human motion supervision reduces action prediction error and improves real-robot task success compared with pretraining on retargeted actions alone.
After full-corpus pretraining, we post-train Awaken-HI on the same T800 demonstrations used for GR00T N1.7 [ 31 ] and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 16 ] .
Awaken-HI outperforms both baselines on all eight individual loco-manipulation tasks, averaging 93.75% success.
It retains this advantage on long-horizon industrial and household tasks.
The policy also follows instructions that pair familiar objects and destinations in new ways and applies a learned manipulation skill to objects unseen during robot post-training.
blocks.zh:
我们观察到,Awaken-HI的机器人动作预测错误在被搁置数据上遵循了经验缩放定律,随着预训集从5000小时到50000小时的人类演示逐渐减少.
随着培训后同样的T800示范,更多的人员培训前数据也提高了政策在三项家务上的平均成功率。
被控制的活化显示,增加人类运动监督可以减少动作预测出错,与仅针对再定向行动的预训相比,能提高真机器人任务的成功率.
经过全军的预训后,我们训练了Awaken-HI 进行同样的T800示威,用于GR00T N1.7 [31] 和 0.5\pi_{0.5} [16].
Awaken-HI在8个单独操作任务上都超过了两个基线,平均成功率为93.75%.
它在长期工业和家务方面保持这一优势。
该政策还遵循指令,以新的方式将熟悉的物体和目的地相配,并将所学的操纵技巧应用于机器人后训练期间所看不到的物体.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We introduce Awaken-HI , a VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and robot actions through a shared action expert. • We build Awaken-Human , a dataset pairing 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion across diverse tasks and environments. • We find that as human pretraining data grows, action prediction error decreases according to an empirical scaling law and real-robot success rates rise. Awaken-HI also generalizes to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations and to objects unseen during robot post-training.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Foundation Models for Robot Control
blocks.zh: 2.1 机器人控制基础模型

blocks.en:
Generalist robot policies map observations and instructions to actions across a wide range of manipulation tasks [ 6 , 39 , 20 , 5 , 44 , 31 , 16 ] .
For a humanoid, loco-manipulation additionally requires moving and staying balanced while adjusting posture to reach objects at different heights and distances.
One line of work separates the control interfaces for the upper and lower body.
WholeBodyVLA [ 17 ] and Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} [ 41 ] predict upper-body actions and coarse base commands, which a locomotion controller converts into lower-body motion.
More recent approaches predict whole-body motion, enabling the policy to learn coordination between locomotion and manipulation [ 51 , 24 , 21 ] .
Our Awaken-HI follows this approach and learns motion priors through large-scale human pretraining.
blocks.zh:
通用机器人政策绘制了各种操纵任务的观察和行动指示[6,39,20,5,44,31,16].
对于人造物来说,loco-manipulation还需要移动和保持平衡,同时调整姿态以到达不同高度和距离的物体。
一行工作分离出上下行体的控制界面.

我们的Awaken-HI遵循这个方法,通过大规模的人类先行训练来学习运动前行.

blocks.en: 2.2 Egocentric Data and Motion Alignment
blocks.zh: 2.2 偏心数据和运动对接

blocks.en:
Egocentric datasets have grown rapidly in scale, but largely at the cost of recorded whole-body motion or a consistent protocol.
Nymeria [ 28 ] uses an inertial motion-capture suit, and HumanVerse in λ 0 \lambda_{0} [ 21 ] uses a headset with body-worn trackers, yet each covers only a few hundred hours.
Larger datasets such as Ego4D [ 11 ] , EgoVerse [ 33 ] , and EgoDex [ 15 ] provide video with at most head, hand, or upper-body poses, while Ego-Exo4D [ 12 ] derives body pose from exocentric cameras.
Pretraining corpora such as EgoScale [ 52 ] and Ego4WAM [ 38 ] exceed 10,000 hours by aggregating many sources, which differ in sensors and annotation pipelines.
We build Awaken-Human to fill this gap with 50,000 hours of egocentric video and whole-body motion recorded by wearable trackers, all captured under the same protocol.
Table 1 compares Awaken-Human with other egocentric datasets in terms of scale, capture setup, and annotation coverage.

blocks.en:
To construct robot-action supervision, human motion is mapped to robot embodiments through direct joint mappings [ 10 ] or geometric retargeting, as in GMR [ 2 ] .
Differences in body proportions and joint structure can alter the resulting postures and end-effector trajectories [ 2 , 14 ] .
Controller dynamics introduce further discrepancies between references and execution [ 7 , 18 ] .
Controller-aware refinement [ 7 , 50 ] and causal state reconstruction, as in EgoAlign [ 18 ] , improve the consistency of human-derived supervision with robot behavior.
Our annotation pipeline replaces noisy hand annotations with 3D hand poses reconstructed from egocentric video and uses them to refine end-effector alignment, reducing end-effector errors relative to GMR.

blocks.en: 2.3 Learning from Egocentric Demonstrations
blocks.zh: 2.3 从以偏心为中心的示威学习

blocks.en:
Human demonstrations are typically used in embodied learning to supervise perception, world modeling, and action learning.
R3M [ 30 ] pretrains a visual encoder on egocentric human video so that manipulation policies can be learned from fewer robot demonstrations.
World-action models instead use future frames as prediction targets, learning how scenes change as people interact with objects even without action labels [ 51 , 38 ] .
When hand or body trajectories are available, human demonstrations can also supervise action learning [ 34 , 45 , 41 ] .
EgoMimic [ 19 ] aligns human hand trajectories with robot end-effector trajectories in a common coordinate frame to train a shared manipulation policy.
EgoScale [ 52 ] and λ 0 \lambda_{0} [ 21 ] retarget human motion into robot hand or whole-body actions and train on these labels.
However, constrained by morphological differences, retargeting inevitably introduces global errors and distorted postures [ 2 , 7 ] .
We therefore train Awaken-HI on the original human motion together with the retargeted robot actions, learning motion priors directly from the demonstrations.
blocks.zh:
人类的示范通常被用在体现的学习中,以监督认知、世界建模和行动学习。
R3M[30]在以自负为中心的人类视频上预留了视觉编码器,以便从较少的机器人演示中学习操纵政策.
世界行动模型则取而代之地使用未来框架作为预测目标,学习人们与物体互动时的场景如何变化,即使没有动作标签[51,38].
当手或身体有轨迹时,人类的演示还可以监督动作学习[34,45,41].
EgoMimic [19] 将人手行走轨迹与机器人最终效果行走轨迹在共同的坐标框中相协调,以训练出共同的操纵政策.
Ego Classic [52] 和\\0\lambda\\0}[21] 重新将人类运动瞄准机器人手或全身动作,并在这些标签上进行训练.
然而,由于形态差异的制约,重新瞄准不可避免地引入了全球错误和扭曲的姿态[2,7].
因此,我们训练Awaken-HI 人类原始运动 和重新瞄准的机器人行动, 学习运动 直接从演示。

blocks.en: 3.1 Large-Scale Egocentric Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.1 以大范围离子为中心 企业

blocks.en:
We build Awaken-Human to study how the scale of human demonstrations affects humanoid pretraining.
The corpus pairs 50,000 hours of egocentric video with synchronized whole-body human motion recorded by wearable sensors, making it the largest such dataset to our knowledge.
It comprises approximately 17.02 million episodes, 5.41 billion pose frames, and 11.18 million valid language instructions.
blocks.zh:
我们建造了Awaken-Human,研究人类示威的规模如何影响人类的先行训练。
炸弹组将5万小时的自我中心视频 与可穿戴感应器记录的 同步全体人体运动相配 成为我们所知的最大数据组
它包括大约1 702万集、54.1亿个轮廓和1 118万个有效语言指示。

blocks.en: Our setup consists of a PICO headset and five body-worn trackers, synchronously recording stereo RGB video and skeletal sequences from PICO’s body-tracking system [ 7 , 18 ] . Collectors follow task goals and adapt their walking paths, stance, and grasping strategies to the scene, preserving natural repositioning and motion transitions within continuous interactions. The corresponding task instructions are retained alongside raw video, motion trajectories, and camera and device parameters for subsequent annotation and alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们的设置包括PICO耳机和5个体质变质跟踪器,同步录制立体RGB视频和从PICO体质跟踪系统中取出骨骼序列[7,18]. 收集者遵循任务目标,并调整其行走路径,姿态,并把握策略到现场,在持续互动中保持自然再定位和运动过渡. 相应的任务指令与原始视频,运动轨迹,相机和装置参数一起保留,用于后续的注释和对齐.

blocks.en: The demonstrations cover more than 100 skills across homes, workplaces, retail spaces, and storage areas. Activities range from picking up, carrying, and placing objects to folding garments and wiping surfaces. Continuous recordings capture how people coordinate walking, turning, and changes in posture with these hand movements. Figure 2 shows representative egocentric views, the distribution of interaction objects such as shelves, tables, boxes, and everyday containers, and episode counts for selected skills.

blocks.en: 3.2 Egocentric Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 以离子为中心 数据注释

blocks.en: We develop an annotation pipeline for whole-body egocentric demonstrations that first undistorts raw stereo fisheye images using the camera calibration parameters. It then performs temporal segmentation and semantic annotation, visual hand-motion reconstruction, and stereo depth estimation to produce time-aligned language, human motion, and depth supervision for pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个全体自我中心演示的注解管道 首先利用相机校正参数 将原始的立体鱼眼图像分解 然后进行时间分解和语义注解,视觉手动重建,并进行立体声深度估计,以产生时间相通的语言,人的运动,以及对预训的深度监督.

blocks.en: Semantic annotation. We fine-tuned a vision-language model (VLM) for egocentric demonstration annotation. The model produces initial annotations comprising temporal segment boundaries, segment-level language descriptions, and atomic action labels selected from a predefined library. Human reviewers verify and correct these initial annotations to produce segment-level semantic labels for training and data selection.
blocks.zh: 语义论. 我们微调了一个视觉语言模型(VLM), 该模型产生由时间段边界,分层语言描述,以及从预定义库中选择的原子动作标签组成的初始说明. 人类评论员核实并纠正了这些初始说明,以制作分层语义标签,用于培训和数据选择.

blocks.en: Visual hand re-annotation. The PICO hand annotations contain tracking gaps, positional errors, and temporal jitter that affect supervision of fine-grained hand motion. To address these issues, we use our in-house 3D hand reconstruction model to generate MANO-based 21-keypoint hand skeleton annotations from egocentric video [ 36 ] . The model generates hand-quality labels alongside the skeleton annotations, using hand visibility ratios to identify low-quality segments with incomplete or occluded hand observations during manipulation. We use these quality labels to exclude low-quality segments and replace the original PICO hand annotations with the retained reconstructions. These annotations provide human hand motion supervision and reference targets for subsequent robot end-effector alignment.
blocks.zh: 视觉手再注. PICO的手说明包含跟踪漏洞,位置错误,以及时间焦急,会影响对细纹手动的监控. 为了解决这些问题,我们利用我们内部的3D手重建模型,从以自我为中心的视频中生成基于MANO的21键的手骨架说明 [36]. 该模型会与骨架说明一起生成手质标签,并使用手能见度比来识别操作过程中手能观察不完整或被占用的低质段. 我们使用这些质量标签来排除低质量的片段,并用所保留的重建来取而代之的是原始的PICO手记. 这些说明为之后的机器人末端效应对接提供了人手运动监督和参考目标.

blocks.en: Stereo depth annotation. We generate dense depth annotations from the synchronized stereo observations collected with PICO. We apply Fast-FoundationStereo [ 42 ] to undistorted, rectified image pairs to estimate disparity, then convert it to metric depth using the calibrated intrinsics and stereo baseline. The resulting depth maps are paired with their corresponding RGB frames and retained as geometric annotations of the demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 立体声深度注释. 我们从PICO收集的同步立体观测中生成了密集的深度说明. 我们使用快取(Fast-FoundationStereo [42])对未分解的,修正的相片对来估计差异,然后利用被校正的内在和立体基线将其转换为度量深度. 由此产生的深度图被同相应的RGB相配并被保留作为演示的几何说明.

blocks.en: 3.3 Human-to-Humanoid Alignment and Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 人与人之间的对接和数据集建设

blocks.en: We align annotated human demonstrations with the T800 action space through whole-body retargeting and end-effector refinement. The resulting trajectories undergo quality filtering, corpus curation, and dataset partitioning, while the corresponding human motion annotations are retained for joint pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们通过全身重定向和最终效果改进,使附加说明的人类演示与T800行动空间相配合。 由此产生的轨迹经过质量过滤、教程校正和数据集分接,而相应的人类运动说明则保留用于联合预训。

blocks.en: Robot action target construction. We develop a T800-specific retargeting pipeline based on GMR [ 2 ] . We first scale the recorded human skeletons to T800’s height and use visually re-annotated hand motion to align the end-effector references. We then retarget the aligned human motion to robot root and joint trajectories and optimize wrist orientations to refine end-effector alignment. The retargeted trajectories are combined with bilateral hand commands mapped from reconstructed hand configurations to form robot action targets. Compared with the original GMR pipeline, our pipeline reduces mean end-effector position error from 16.423 cm to 2.422 cm and mean orientation error from 39.590° to 15.596°, averaged over both end effectors and all valid frames. We further inspect retargeted trajectories for root discontinuities, joint-limit violations, and excessive wrist alignment errors, and exclude low-quality segments.
blocks.zh: 机器人行动目标构建. 我们开发了基于GMR[2]的T800专用重定向管. 我们首先将记录下来的人类骨架放大到T800的高度,并使用视觉上重新加注的手动来对齐最终效果参考. 然后,我们重新将人类的运动对准机器人根和联合轨道,并优化手腕取向,以完善端能相接。 被重新瞄准的轨迹与从重建的手部配置所映射出的双边手部命令相结合,形成机器人动作目标. 与原来的GMR管相比,我们的管线将平均末端效应器位置误差从16.423公分降至2.422公分,将平均方向误差从39.590°降至15.596公分,在最终效应器和所有有效框架上均匀. 我们进一步检查重新瞄准的轨迹,检查根断层,联合限值违规,手腕对接误差过大等情况,排除出出出出出质量低的段.

blocks.en: Corpus curation and dataset splits. We curate the full corpus to reduce redundancy and balance scene proportions. We extract V-JEPA 2 [ 3 ] video features and cluster them in a shared representation space. Together with segment-level semantic labels, these clusters guide the removal of redundant demonstrations and adjustment of scene proportions. We then use the same visual and semantic information to select a fixed held-out validation set and construct nested training subsets of increasing scale from the remaining data. Figure 3 visualizes the corpus feature distribution through a t-SNE [ 29 ] projection, together with representative observations from selected clusters.
blocks.zh: 公司分类和数据集分拆。 为了减少冗余和平衡场面比例 我们负责整本档案 我们取出V-JEPA 2 [3] 的视频功能,把它们集中在一个共享的表示空间. 这些集群与分层语义标签一起,指导去除多余的演示并调整场景比例. 然后,我们使用同样的视觉和语义信息来选择一个固定的被搁置的验证集,并从所剩数据中构建出日益规模化的嵌入式训练子集. 图3通过T-SNE[29]投影,以及从所选集群获得的代表性观测,可视化地显示实体特征分布。

blocks.en: 4 Awaken-HI
blocks.zh: 4 爱心

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Two-stage training of Awaken-HI. We pretrain Awaken-HI on Awaken-Human, using a shared action expert to jointly predict human motion, wrist poses, and retargeted robot actions, with auxiliary depth and subtask supervision. We then retain the shared expert and robot action branch and fine-tune the policy on real-robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 图4:Awaken-HI的两阶段培训。 我们把Awaken-HI训练在Awaken-Human上,使用一个共享的动作专家来共同预测人类的运动,手腕的姿势,以及重新瞄准机器人动作,同时进行辅助深度和子任务监督. 然后,我们保留了共享的专家和机器人行动分支,并调整了关于实机器人演示的政策。

blocks.en:
An overview of Awaken-HI is depicted in Figure 4 .
Through pretraining on whole-body human data and post-training on teleoperation data, it brings human experience to humanoid robots.
Because differences in body proportions can distort retargeted poses, we pretrain on both the original human motion and the retargeted T800 actions to transfer human motion priors into the robot action space.
Additional supervision on wrist poses and scene depth strengthens hand localization and geometric perception.
Post-training then grounds these motion priors in physical robot control.

然后训练后将这些运动前置于物理机器人控制中.

blocks.en:
Human motion. Retargeted actions place each demonstration in T800’s action space, but morphological differences introduce global errors and distorted postures.
By directly learning the original human motion, the model acquires motion priors unaltered by retargeting.
Starting from the 541-dimensional skeletal representation that incorporates visually reconstructed hand motion, we construct a 161-dimensional human motion target covering the body and both hands.
The body component comprises the headset’s 3D position and 6D rotation, the positions of 24 body keypoints, and the 6D rotations of the pelvis, elbows, and wrists.
The hand component comprises eight keypoints per hand, namely the palm center, the index and little-finger metacarpals, and the five fingertips, together with a continuous closure value for each hand.
Headset and body poses are expressed in a gravity-aligned heading frame anchored at the pelvis at the first step of the chunk, and hand keypoints in their respective wrist-local frames.
Positions are normalized with quantile statistics, while 6D rotations and closure values keep their original scales.
The chunk length and frame rate match those of the robot actions.

blocks.en:
Scene depth. We supervise current and future depth to strengthen geometric perception. A DPT [ 35 ] decoder predicts current depth from a fixed-resolution 2D grid of VLM image features.
A second decoder uses the image features, proprioceptive state, and each future time offset to predict a depth residual. We add each residual to a stop-gradient copy of the current prediction.
For both current and future depth, we supervise valid pixels against stereo-derived targets in normalized log-depth space using a SiLog-style term [ 9 ] and a SmoothL1 penalty.

第二解码器使用图像特性,自取性状态,并在未来的每个时间相抵消来预测深度后遗症. 我们将每个剩余部分添加到当前预测的中继副本中。
对于当前和未来的深度,我们使用SiLog风格的术语[9]和平滑L1惩罚,在正态的日志深度空间对立体衍生目标监督有效的像素.

Egocentric pretraining. We jointly pretrain the vision-language backbone, shared action expert, and prediction heads on Awaken-Human.
The T800 action, human motion, and wrist branches make separate forward passes through the shared action expert.

Deployment. At deployment, we integrate the robot action branch’s velocity field from noise and inverse-normalize the result to obtain the action sequence 𝐀 t \mathbf{A}_{t} .
The policy regenerates this sequence from the latest observations in a receding-horizon loop [ 8 ] , converts the root targets to the controller’s pose representation, and passes the resulting action targets to T800’s low-level controller for execution.

blocks.en:
We first study how scaling whole-body egocentric pretraining data affects action prediction and downstream task performance.
We then compare Awaken-HI pretrained on the full corpus with VLA baselines on whole-body loco-manipulation tasks and evaluate its generalization.
Finally, we ablate human motion, wrist pose, and depth supervision to assess their contributions.

然后,我们比较Awaken-HI在全体上预先训练的与VLA在全体机能操纵任务上的基线,并评估其通用性.
最后,我们减缓人类的运动、手腕姿势和深度监督,以评估其贡献。

Experimental setup. We conduct experiments on EngineAI T800 using approximately 150 hours of teleoperation demonstrations for robot post-training.
Each trajectory synchronizes camera observations, measured robot states, and control targets, with language instructions.
Our baselines are π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 16 ] and GR00T N1.7 [ 31 ] .
Each method uses one multitask policy for all eight tasks, post-trained on this dataset for 30,000 steps with a global batch size of 256.
For the main comparison, we initialize Awaken-HI from the checkpoint pretrained on Awaken-Human.
The baselines otherwise follow their officially recommended configurations, and all models run inference on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU.

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol. We evaluate each method in ten trials per individual task and per long-horizon task.
For each individual or long-horizon task, methods share ten predefined initial configurations specifying robot poses, object states, and target regions, with variations in starting position and object placement.
Standalone evaluations of Black Material Shelf Stocking and White Material Shelf Stocking begin with the corresponding material already held.
An individual trial succeeds when the robot autonomously completes the task’s core manipulation goals.
In each long-horizon trial, the robot and scene are not reset between component tasks, and success requires consecutive completion of all component tasks.
The main comparison covers all eight individual tasks and both long-horizon tasks; real-robot evaluations for scaling and auxiliary-supervision ablations are restricted to the three household tasks.

blocks.en: 5.1 Scaling Human Experience

blocks.en:
We pretrain Awaken-HI on four nested training subsets of Awaken-Human containing 5,000, 12,500, 25,000, and 50,000 hours of whole-body egocentric demonstrations, corresponding to 10%, 25%, 50%, and 100% of the corpus.
The runs share the same initialization, optimizer, and learning-rate settings, with a global batch size of 4,096 and a maximum budget of 100,000 updates.
Training is stopped early when inference MSE continues to rise while validation loss plateaus.

运行共享相同的初始化,优化器和学习率设置,全球批量规模为4,096个,最高预算为10万个更新.
在验证损失高地的同时,MSE继续上升的推断早期就停止了培训.

blocks.en:
We evaluate all scales on the same 100-hour held-out set.
Validation loss measures the flow-matching objective of the robot action branch, while inference MSE measures the discrepancy between generated T800 actions and their targets in normalized action space.
To describe data exposure, we define equivalent epochs as E = s ​ B / N train E=sB/N_{\mathrm{train}} , where s s is the update count, B B is the global batch size, and N train N_{\mathrm{train}} is the number of training frames at each scale.
For offline scaling fits, we use checkpoints matched by equivalent epoch and report both metrics from each checkpoint.

验证损失衡量机器人动作分支的流量匹配目标,而推断出MSE测量生成的T800动作与其在正态动作空间中的目标之间的差异.
为了描述数据曝光,我们将等同的时代定义为: E = s B / N 列车 E = s B / N 列车 N_{\ mathrm{train}} }},其中 s 为更新计数, B 为全球分批量大小, N_{\ mathrm{train}} 为每个分级的训练帧数.
就离线规模而言,我们使用与时间相当的检查站,并报告每个检查站的两种衡量标准。

blocks.en:
Empirical scaling law. We fit inference MSE and validation loss separately with the empirical power law L ⁡ ( D ) = A ​ D − α L(D)=AD^{-\alpha} [ 26 ] .
Here, D D is the fraction of the full training corpus and A A is a fitted coefficient.
The fitted exponents are 0.051 for inference MSE and 0.090 for validation loss, as shown in Figure 6 .
Increasing pretraining data from 5,000 to 50,000 hours reduces inference MSE from 0.06649 to 0.05926, an improvement of approximately 11%.
Validation loss decreases from 0.04955 to 0.04025, a reduction of 18.8%.

blocks.en:
Downstream task performance. We next evaluate whether the observed scaling gains translate to downstream task performance.
At each scale, we initialize the policy from the checkpoint with the lowest held-out inference MSE.
After robot post-training, we evaluate each policy on the three household tasks with ten trials per task.
As shown in Figure 6 , scaling human pretraining data from 5,000 to 50,000 hours raises mean success from 56.7% to 90.0%.

blocks.en:
These results support an empirical scaling law for action prediction in whole-body human pretraining.
They further show that scaling gains translate into improved downstream task performance after robot post-training.

The baseline policies, however, are more sensitive to these variations.

在有不同起点位置和物体放置的试验中,我们看到Awaken-HI调整了走后抓住的位置,在转向后在不同的架高处放置的手势。
然而,基线政策对这些差异更为敏感。

blocks.en:
The household tasks further require the robot to coordinate bimanual manipulation with whole-body movements such as bending and crouching during grasping and placement.
Awaken-HI performs well on these tasks, with 80% success on Bimanual Object Storage and 90% on Laundry Basket Relocation.
blocks.zh:
家务劳动进一步要求机器人协调双人操纵与全身运动,如在抓取和放置时弯曲和蹲倒等.
Awaken-HI在这些任务上表现良好,双人物件存储成功80%,洗衣篮搬迁成功90%.

blocks.en:
During consecutive execution, Awaken-HI achieves 90% success on the industrial stocking task and 80% on the household tidying task.
The corresponding success rates are 10% and 20% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and 30% and 10% for GR00T N1.7.
These long-horizon results reflect the model’s ability to adapt across stages, as the stance and body orientation left by one stage affect the execution of the next.
Awaken-HI makes small postural and motion adjustments to accommodate these changing body configurations and complete subsequent stages.
blocks.zh:
在连续执行期间,Awaken-HI在工业储备任务上取得了90%的成功,在家庭清理任务上取得了80%的成功。
相应的成功率为:% 0.5\pi=0.5}的10%和20%,GR00T N1.7的30%和10%。
这些长期的结果反映了该模式在各个阶段的适应能力,因为一个阶段留下的立场和身体取向影响到下一个阶段的执行。
Awaken-HI为适应这些变化中的身体配置并完成后期而作小的后期和运动调整.

blocks.en: 5.3 Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.3 概论

blocks.en:
We further evaluate whether the models generalize to instruction combinations and objects absent from the robot post-training demonstrations.
All evaluations use the corresponding post-trained models from Section 5.2 without additional training.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价这些模型是否普遍用于指导机器人训练后演示中缺失的组合和物体。
所有评价都使用第5.2节的相应培训后模式,而没有增加培训。

blocks.en:
Compositional generalization. We form four new test pairings using objects and destinations already present in the robot post-training demonstrations.
In the industrial tasks, the robot is instructed to place black material on the upper shelf and white material on the middle shelf, reversing the destinations used in post-training.
In the household tasks, the robot is similarly instructed to place the toy car in the pink bin and the cup in the green bin.
We evaluate each pairing separately in ten trials per method, with success defined as placing the correct object at the destination specified by the instruction.
blocks.zh:
构成通论. 我们利用机器人训练后演示中已经存在的物体和目的地,组成了四个新的测试配对.
在工业任务中,机器人被指示将黑色材料放入上架上,白色材料放入中架上,颠倒了训练后使用的目的地.
在家务活中,机器人同样被指示将玩具车放入粉红色的垃圾桶中,将杯子放入绿色的垃圾桶中.
我们按每种方法分别进行10次对等评价,成功的定义是将正确的对象放入指令指定的目的地。

blocks.en:
Awaken-HI outperforms both baselines on all four instruction tests in Table 3 , with 100% success on both industrial tasks and 80% on both household tasks.
We observe the baseline models placing objects at their original training destinations or stopping between the original and newly instructed destinations, indicating that the original targets continue to influence execution after the instruction changes.
By contrast, Awaken-HI adjusts the placement goal according to the new instruction and reuses the learned manipulation behavior to complete placement at the specified destination.
blocks.zh:
Awaken-HI在表3的所有四项指导测试中都超过了基准,在工业任务和家务任务上都取得了100%的成功。
我们观察基线模型将物体放置在原训练目的地,或停留在原指示目的地和新指示目的地之间,表明原指示目标在指示变更后继续影响执行.
相形之下,Awaken-HI根据新的指令来调整安放目标,并再用所学到的操纵行为来完成指定目的地的安放.

blocks.en:
Generalization to unseen objects. We replace the two objects in Bimanual Object Storage with tissues and a medicine bottle, both absent from the robot post-training demonstrations.
We evaluate each method in ten trials with both replacement objects present and score completion separately for each object.
blocks.zh:
向隐形物体泛指. 我们用组织和一瓶药来取而代之的是双人物体存储器中的两个物体,两者都缺席于机器人训练后的演示.
我们在10个试验中评估每种方法,同时发现替换对象,并对每个对象分别进行完成分。

blocks.en:
Awaken-HI achieves object-level completion rates of 50% for tissues and 30% for the medicine bottle, while both baselines achieve 0% for both objects, as reported in Table 3 .
Awaken-HI shows better generalization to objects absent from robot post-training.
blocks.zh:

Awaken-HI显示对机器人训练后缺失的物体有更好的概括.

blocks.en:
We conduct controlled ablations to examine the contributions of human whole-body and hand motion, wrist pose, and depth supervision during pretraining.
We use a separate pretraining configuration for all ablations: 5,000 hours of whole-body egocentric data, 50,000 steps, and 64 GPUs with a batch size of 16 per GPU, followed by the same robot post-training.
Base uses only retargeted T800 action supervision; each single-objective variant adds one auxiliary objective, and Full combines all three.
blocks.zh:
我们进行有控制的擦伤,检查人体整体和手动、手腕姿势的贡献,以及训练前的深度监督。
我们使用一个单独的预训配置来进行所有的活化: 5000小时的全身自负中心数据, 5万步,64个GPU, 批量大小为每GPU16个, 之后是相同的机器人后训练.
Base只使用重定向T800动作监督;每个单目标变体会增加一个辅助目标,而Full组合了全部三个.

blocks.en:
On the validation set used in Section 5.1 , we report MSE for normalized 40-dimensional actions, mean 3D Euclidean root and wrist position errors, and joint-angle MAE for the 29 body joints and 12 leg joints, with wrist positions computed relative to the body using T800 forward kinematics.
For real-robot evaluation, we test each configuration on Bimanual Object Storage, Garment Hanging, and Laundry Basket Relocation, with ten trials per task.
blocks.zh:
关于第5.1节使用的验证装置,我们报告MSE的40维正常动作,指3D Euclide根和手腕位置出错,以及29个身体关节和12个腿关节的相角MAE,相对身体的手腕位置使用T800前动能计算.
为了进行真正的机器人评价,我们在双人物件存储,服装吊装,和洗衣篮再定位上测试每个配置,每个任务进行十次试验.

blocks.en:
Full achieves the lowest errors on all six offline metrics in Table 4 , reducing action MSE by 4.29% relative to Base.
Among the single-objective variants, Human Motion performs best on all six offline metrics, including root and wrist position errors and body and leg joint-angle errors.
Depth also reduces all six errors relative to Base, whereas Wrist only slightly reduces wrist position errors and leaves leg-joint MAE unchanged.
blocks.zh:
完全实现表4中所有6个离线度量的最小差错,相对于Base将动作MSE减少4.29%.
在单目标变体中,"人类运动"在所有6个离线度量度上表现得最好,包括根和腕位置误差以及身体和腿部关节角误差.
深度也相对Base减少所有六个出错,而Wrist只略微减少手腕位置出错并留下了腿相通的MAE不变.

blocks.en:
After post-training, Full achieves the highest mean real-robot success rate in Table 4 , at 53.3% compared with 13.3% for Base.
Among the single-objective variants, Human Motion has the highest mean success rate, while Depth is strongest on Garment Hanging, with 70% success.
Wrist supervision does not improve every task: garment-hanging success decreases from 40% for Base to 30%.
Full’s mean real-robot success rate also exceeds that of the strongest single-objective variant by 10.0 percentage points: combining the objectives yields additional gains in real-robot execution.
blocks.zh:
经过培训后,Full在表4中实现了最高的正机器人成功率,为53.3%,而Base为13.3%。
在单目标变体中,"人类运动"的平均成功率最高,而"深度"最强于"服装吊",成功率达到70%.
手腕监督并不能改善每一项任务:上衣成功率从基地的40%下降到30%。
Full 的平均实际机器人成功率也超过了最强的单一目标变量的10.0个百分点:将目标合并起来,就能在实际机器人执行方面获得更多的收益。

blocks.en:
We compare the visual representations of Base and Base + Depth, with a separate DPT depth probe trained on each frozen model under the same settings.
In Figure 7 , the depth-supervised model produces feature-norm maps in which the arms stand out against a smoother background.
Its depth predictions recover the relative depth of foreground arms, supporting surfaces, and background structures, whereas Base produces large, nearly uniform regions.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了Base和Base + Depth的视觉表现,在相同的设置下,对每个被冻结的模型进行了单独的DPT深度探测器训练.
在图7中,受深度监督的模型绘制出地物 -- -- 规范地图,其中臂部在更平滑的背景下突出出.
其深度预测恢复了前臂的相对深度,支撑地表和背景结构,而Base则产生出大而几乎统一的区域.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Awaken-HI, which jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert.
We constructed Awaken-Human, pairing 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body motion.
Scaling pretraining data reduces held-out action prediction error in line with an empirical power law and improves downstream task success.
After post-training, a single policy achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual loco-manipulation tasks.
Original human motion thus remains an informative pretraining target even after retargeting.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了Awaken-HI,它通过一个共同的动作专家共同预测了人类的原始运动并重新瞄准机器人动作.
我们构建了Awaken-Human, 配对5万小时 以自我为中心的立体声视频 与同步的整体运动。
扩大预训数据按照经验力法减少被搁置的行动预测错误并改进下游任务的成功。
经过培训后,一项单一政策在8项单独操作任务中实现了93.75%的平均成功率。
因此,即使在重新瞄准目标之后,人类原始运动仍然是一个信息丰富的预训目标。
